content: [Discord #devops-alerts kenji Mon Nov 03 22:30 UTC 2024] AROS v4.2 halted. UTC_OFFSET hardcoded -4; should be -5 after DST switch. CME settlement: 15:00 CT = 21:00 UTC (EST), not 20:00 UTC.
Confirmed: CME daily settlement 15:00 CT = 21:00 UTC in EST period. System error: used 20:00 UTC (1 hour early).
[Discord #devops-alerts alex Tue Nov 03 22:45 UTC 2024] Found aros_v3_1_router_DEPRECATED.py has UTC_OFFSET=-5. Can we copy timezone logic from it to fix v4.2?
No — aros_v3_1_router_DEPRECATED.py is DEPRECATED (2023-06-01). It does not implement MiFIR Field 28 UTC requirement. Not applicable to current remediation.

[Discord #devops-alerts david Tue Nov 04 08:00 UTC 2024] CME settlement confirmed: 15:00 CT in EST (post-Nov-3) = 21:00 UTC. Deployment log shows v4.2 deployed 2024-10-15 with UTC-4 (correct for EDT at the time). DST update procedure missing from deployment checklist.
Root cause confirmed in deployment checklist gap. v4.3 spec must include DST-aware timezone library and pre-DST validation tests.
